what: DECL-P4-23 item 2 organizer ink labels on certified T pixels only (DECL-P4-21-A1); never any X pixel
encoding: ink, sup uint8 (ceil(T/4) x ceil(T/4)); 1 = inklabel/supervision 255 at the mapped label px of the nearest covering segment; 0 otherwise or outside the T mask; n_sub = 1 (one sample at each x4 pixel centre)
mapping_rule: exact closest point (uvmap.nearest_uv) at strip vertices; segment UV and distance bilinear inside the strip quad (4 corners mapped, UV span < 3 cells); label px round(uv*20)
